aetherion.title: Aetherion
aetherion.feature.dungeonTimer.desc: Floating run timer with per-boss phase splits
aetherion.feature.skillXpOverlay.desc: Tracks XP gained per action and shows a rate overlay
aetherion.feature.itemRarityTooltip.desc: Highlights a Skyblock item's rarity in its tooltip

aetherion.feature.bestFlip.desc: Highlights bazaar products with a large buy/sell spread
